stepper implements the rules and that every reconstructed physical leaf
has this intended tree is U-REF. The exhaustive raw resume-state transition
encoding for all these expression tags is U-NUM; the semantic grammar alone does not
certify a physical implementation.

definitions.title: Canonical certificate equations
definitions.tex:
For $|v|\le1$, the target certificate property is $|N_t-2^tv|<2$. Digits are
$N_0$ and $N_t-2N_{t-1}$, with residue decoding in $[-8,7]$; they have magnitude
less than six. A primitive state returns either a named operand/place request or
a completed residue, and retains the finite phase, loop indices, branch tags,
markers, residues and pending bounded digits listed in its contract.

For an affine sum $v=2^{-e}\sum_i c_ix_i$, put
$A=\sum_i|c_i|$, $h=\lceil\log_2(96A)\rceil+1$,
$T=\max(0,t-e+h)$, $H=T+e-t$. Its certificate is
\[
 N_t=\left\lfloor 2^{-H}\sum_i c_i\sum_{j=0}^T x_{i,j}2^{T-j}\right\rfloor.
\]
For a fixed continuous piecewise-affine expression with Lipschitz constant $L_F$,
use operand prefixes through $t+h_F$ with $6L_F2^{-h_F}<1$; choose the piece
by those finite prefixes and the fixed tie rule, then take its scaled floor.
Size/threshold/default use $h_F=8$, compression $h_F=10$, after the declared
common-scale normalization. Differences of compression pieces have coefficient
norm at most 48; with digit magnitude six the absorbing comparison threshold is
289. A simple two-prefix difference uses threshold 13. These are finite-prefix
comparisons, never tests of equality of limiting reals.

For multiplication, band zero has $\min(i,j)=0$; positive dyadic band $\delta$
has $\delta\le\min(i,j)<2\delta$. With $h_0=16$ and
$h_\delta=16+\lfloor\delta/4\rfloor$, set
\begin{align*}
 S_\delta=\sum_{\substack{(i,j)\text{ in band }\delta\\i+j\le t+h_\delta}}
 x_i y_j2^{t+h_\delta-i-j},&\\
 F_\delta=S_\delta+\left\lfloor F_{\delta^+}/2^{h_{\delta^+}-h_\delta}\right\rfloor,
 &\qquad N_t=\lfloor F_0/2^{16}\rfloor.
\end{align*}
The last included band has no successor term. For a reciprocal choose fixed
$C,c_r$ as in the source so the quadratic remainder is at most $2^{-t}/16$;
with $k=\lfloor t/2\rfloor+c_r$, $x_0=\sum_{j\le k}x_j2^{-j}$,
$\alpha=1/(Cx_0)$, $\beta=-1/(Cx_0^2)$ and tail digits
$e_j=0$ for $j\le k$, $e_j=x_j$ otherwise, define
\[
 N_t(1/(Cx))=\left\lfloor
 N_{t+3}\bigl(\operatorname{clip}_{[0,1]}(\alpha+\beta e)\bigr)/8
 \right\rfloor.
\]
The inner certificate has its declared normalization; $t$ remains captured in
all coefficient requests. A largest-first rank compares prefixes through $t+8$,
with smaller-index ties, and floors the selected prefix at place $t$.
For an incoming score rank at place $t$, multiply each score's
prefix through $t+8$ by $2^t$, take its floor, and clip that integer
to $[0,2^t]$. The certificate is the required order statistic
of these integers with zero padding.
These equations select actual finite certificates; merely supplying another
sequence with error less than two would not preserve structural tests.

definitions.title: The remaining construction and proof boundaries
definitions.tex:
\textbf{U-CATALOG.} Both modes need the exact finite terminal/query library: labels, legal raw slot shapes, partial-fill phases, bounded edits, predecessor certificates, complete links and restoring portals. Run 7 supplies a candidate instruction grammar with short address fields. Its audit did not establish the concrete source-library instantiation. The full mode additionally needs a layout without those per-record address costs.

\textbf{U-NUM.} The equations and named operand handlers do not yet specify every resume transition, leaf schema and scale adapter. A reciprocal must preserve its originating place while rebuilding coefficients, and erase early words before late operand calls. These obligations apply in both modes.

\textbf{U-REF.} The stored-tree logical reference and the reconstructed physical expressions must agree in finite certificates, padded default operands, port order and structural tests. Equality of limiting real values is insufficient.

The normalization, compression, caller-law identifications and simultaneous constant choices also remain open. A-ACTION proves a gap for the specified finite product action under the two external Shalom contracts; it does not prove the estimator's conditional-mean identities. Full-space additions require adaptive block comparison and $q=1$ field bounds. These premises remain open here.

definitions.title: Hash blocks, effective keys and fixed masks
definitions.tex:
For $h_*=\lfloor\epsilon\log_2B\rfloor\ge1$, set
$\mathcal I_b=\{bh_*,\ldots,(b+1)h_*-1\}$ for $b\ge0$, keeping blocks that
meet $\{0,\ldots,M\}$; pad small inputs so this holds. Each block
has its own $O(\log B)$ fair bits, for $O(B)$ bits in total. A query's effective
key is the block key after replaying its seed transformations. In comparisons
at slack $d>2h_*$ use exact endpoint-bit equality; otherwise use that key.
A task in block $b$ may inspect only effective keys with indices at most $b$.
Its conditional walk varies keys of index less than $b$ and fixes every key
of index at least $b$. This rule covers values, port order, validity and
predecessor tests. The mask is a public function of the budget block; no key
value chooses it. The block reference changes comparisons, not this mask.

definitions.title: The exact within-block comparison
definitions.tex:
The exact within-block reference replaces every same-block comparison by exact
equality, recursively, while preserving lower-block actual computations. Its
key-independent candidate/witness set is \id{A-CANDIDATES}. The fixed-pair
collision estimate alone cannot establish adaptive accuracy. \id{A-HASH}
asks for the cubic comparison with these candidates, including structural
choices. The choice of cubic rather than eighth-root analysis is a substantive
review decision and an open proof obligation.

definitions.title: Conditioning for the adaptive comparison
definitions.tex: For a block-$b$ task use its effective seed coordinates. Let $\mathcal G_b$ fix all coordinates except that block's original fair bits. Its conditional key law is therefore exactly the fair-bit law of P-KEY, including its biased reductions modulo the hash prime. Let $\mathcal E_x$ be A-CANDIDATES' set of at most $2^{C_Eh_*}$ endpoints, and $\mathcal C_x$ the event of a collision between distinct members. The source hit and the reference propagation envelope must be $\mathcal G_b$-measurable. The event that an actual candidate leaves $\mathcal E_x$ may depend on the current key and is never added to $\mathcal G_b$.

definitions.title: Error allocation within one block
definitions.tex:
Let $b h_*\le m<(b+1)h_*$ and choose fixed constants $C,d_1,d_2>0$. For $r$ in this block set $\lambda_r=2^{-d_1h_*+d_2(r-bh_*)}$, and set $\lambda_r=0$ below it, where the actual and reference children coincide. A child of slack $d$ has $r\le m-d$. All counts of descriptor types, budget layers, scale changes, witness transfers and final-gate comparisons must be included in $2^{Cd}$. For a row, its per-source discrepancy is the cube root of the destination-weighted sum of cubed differences in the metric prescribed by \Dref{D-ERROR}; for a vector it is the absolute difference. The source-weighted norm of this quantity is exactly that \Dref{D-ERROR} norm. Let $e_m$ be the maximum of $2^{p_{\rm acc}}$ times this norm over the finitely many legal tasks and output types at budget $m$. The required relative comparison recurrence is
\[
 e_m\le \sum_{d=1}^{2h_*}2^{Cd}\max_{\substack{r\in\mathcal I_b\\r\le m-d}} e_r
             +2^{Ch_*}B^{-1/6},
\]
where an empty maximum is zero and the absolute \Dref{D-ERROR} discrepancy is $2^{-p_{\rm acc}}e_m$. This is a quantitative requirement, not an established bound for the present source library.

definitions.title: What the full layout must save
definitions.tex: The full implementation uses \Dref{D-RESOURCE} at $q=1$. Across a tight comparison it saves relative codes and finite phase/result bits, with no retained fingerprint or bit-position word.
